about: All eight are ideas for one app: a tool for making motion graphics, where shapes and type are animated on a timeline.
glyphs: A ball bouncing: one solid ball, and behind it a dotted arc of smaller dots showing the path it took.
An animation timeline: three short horizontal bars stacked, each with a diamond keyframe on it, and one vertical playhead line crossing them.
An easing curve: a thick S-shaped curve going from the bottom left to the top right inside a square frame, with a round handle at each end.
A square turning into a circle: three shapes overlapping in a row, the first a square, the middle a rounded square, the last a circle.
A play triangle with three horizontal speed lines trailing behind it on the left.
A four-point star with two curved arrows around it, as if it is spinning.
Three diamond keyframes joined by one smooth wavy path, the middle diamond higher than the others.
Three rounded frames fanned out like a hand of cards, with a play triangle on the front one.
